frontPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FRONT master image for multi-view image-to-3D reconstruction in Tripo3D, one isolated complete character.
Reference image: approved Mao 5070 appearance and costume identity, NOT its poses or poster layout.
Subject: Mao 5070, explicitly an adult woman age 25, refined anime character. Same mature face, platinum short bob, violet eyes, white five-petal flower and purple ribbon on HER ANATOMICAL LEFT temple (viewer right in this front view). Ivory fitted stage bodice with large dark exact text "5070" across front only; navy and purple off-shoulder cropped jacket with loose sleeves and white cuffs, gold trim/clasps, matching short layered navy skirt with purple underskirt, dark opaque tights, dark ankle boots with gold buckles and medium block heels. Fully clothed adult stage costume. Balanced adult proportions with slender legs and ordinary-sized hands and boots, approximately 7.5 heads tall. Preserve the design without exaggerating chest or hips.
Pose: rigidly consistent neutral symmetric A-pose for rigging: both straight arms point 30 degrees away from the body below horizontal, hands clear of waist and skirt, wrists straight, fingers extended naturally slightly separated, palms oriented forward. Legs straight and parallel, feet separated at hip width, feet straight ahead, both heels on the same level, NO crossed legs, NO contrapposto, NO waving. Head upright, neutral relaxed closed-mouth expression, eyes straight forward.
Camera: exact centered orthographic FRONT view at 0 degrees, no tilt or perspective distortion. Entire character from top of hair to bottom of boots visible, same scale across future views. Portrait 1024x1536 canvas, character approx 90% image height with margins; centered.
Style: polished anime 3D character turnaround render, coherent physical sculpt and clean materials, detailed but controlled. Soft even studio illumination, no dramatic directional shadows, no baked rim glow. Pure white seamless background, no environment or cast shadow.
Constraints: ONLY one full-body view. No panels, labels, frame, watermark, UI, floor plane, props or duplicated limbs. The only text is "5070" on the front bodice. Stable silhouette suitable for generating a single 3D character.
